title: EzSaturation
description: Adds a simple slider which allows you to change saturation
body:
### EzSaturation

EzSaturation is an ultra-lightweight shader pack for Iris Shaders that adds a configurable Saturation Slider, allowing you to adjust the color intensity of Minecraft without affecting lighting, shadows, or overall performance.

Designed to be simple and efficient, EzSaturation only modifies color saturation, making it ideal for players who want a more vibrant or more muted visual experience while maintaining the game's original look.


<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

Features
Adjustable saturation slider
Extremely lightweight with minimal performance impact
Does not modify lighting, shadows, reflections, or other visual effects
Compatible with Iris Shaders
Simple plug-and-play installation
Saturation Showcase

</details>



- The saturation slider supports the following values:

0.0 0.05 0.10 0.15 0.20 0.25 0.30 0.35 0.40 0.45
0.50 0.55 0.60 0.65 0.70 0.75 0.80 0.85 0.90 0.95
1.00 1.05 1.10 1.15 1.20 1.25 1.30 1.35 1.40 1.45
1.50 1.55 1.60 1.65 1.70 1.75 1.80 1.85 1.90 1.95
2.00 3.00 100

- Slider Reference
Value	Result
0.0	Completely desaturated (grayscale)
1.0	Default Minecraft saturation
2.0	Twice the default saturation
3.0	Extremely vibrant colors
100	Maximum saturation for experimentation
Supported Versions
Minecraft 1.17 through 1.21.8 (Iris 1.7.x–1.8.x / Minecraft 1.17–1.21.8)
Iris Shaders v1.7.0+ (including Iris 1.8.x)
GLSL Version 120 and above

**Note: Version support may expand with future updates.**
